what: chains alone in a box and one chain to a cell, PBE-D3(BJ) at 90/360 Ry (examples/chain_triage.py); polarisation by the Berry phase with norm-conserving files on the same geometry

units.rise_a: A a repeat along the chain
units.volume_a3: A3 a repeat (a lone chain's is its box)
units.dipole_across_e_a: e A a repeat, across the chain, from the charge density
units.stretch: nN per unit strain of the chain
units.piezo: c GPa, e C/m2 (pN/nm2 per V/um), d pm/V

facings.name: pvdf_tt_x1
facings.what: every chain turned together about its axis and relaxed in DFT with the cell held; energies in eV for the cell, stress in GPa in the row's frame (x the row, y across it, z the chain), tension positive
